title: opjson sets
description: sets/sets.json: every set a printing can belong to. Bandai's series in English and Japanese, plus the TCGplayer groups that are not one Bandai series (stamp groups and promo lines).

type.description: The set's product line. AutoMana maps it onto MTG's set types: booster=expansion, premium_booster=masters, starter_deck and ultra_deck=starter, box_set=box.

bandaiSeriesId.description: The series id on Bandai's English card list. The Japanese list's id is in the ja release's source.

block.description: The block printed on the set's own cards, which Bandai assigns by release year. Absent on promo and other-product sets, which span blocks, and on stamp sets, which take their parent's.

parent.description: The set this one hangs off, as MTG's parent_set: a pre-release, release-event or anniversary stamp set names the booster whose printings it stamps.

source.description: Present when the set exists only on TCGplayer.

logo.description: The set's logo, hotlinked from the Bandai product page that shows it (source). Absent when Bandai shows none.

keyArt.description: The main visual on the set's Bandai product page (source), or for a booster without one its pack's TCGplayer picture: its pixel size, and the crop [x, y, width, height] that keeps only the artwork when the image holds more (a banner's date band and pack shot, a pack's header and title). Absent when the page shows none.
